structured.answer: I can take it out tax-free 6 years after the first deposit (or before that for studies, or after 3 years if you're at retirement age). With 300 ₪ a month from me and 900 from the employer, the example says that after 5 years about 50k ₪ goes into your account before tax, and a big chunk of that goes to tax if you take it early. I never saw the number for 6 years, so roughly 50–65k is my guess.

stuck.why: It's set to 5 years by default, but 6 years is the tax-free point I actually care about. The page never shows the 6-year number in text.
+54,000, +8,487, −13,974, then '66,5…' cut off on the left under the arrow button. I couldn't tell what I actually end up with.
50,719 goes in, 29,768 goes to tax, 15,794 comes back. Three numbers that don't match the bars above, and I lost track of what's mine.
